title: Parliament translations
description: House of Representatives notices and National Assembly verbatims, OCR'd from the published PDFs and translated to English by a fixed-schema Gemini call. Each document has raw Devanagari OCR, an English translation, and a structured JSON record (session, sections, speakers, bills, tags).
grain: one structured JSON record per document

coverage.note: Verbatims are segmented into 10k-character chunks with checkpoints; only the merged JSON is committed

artifacts.description: Document text: English translation, except files suffixed -ocr.txt which are the raw Devanagari OCR they were produced from.

verification.method: prose, so there are no printed totals to reconcile; every structured record is stored beside the OCR text that produced it, and per-document status (done / failed / no_pdf) is tracked in the inventories

notes: 34 of 70 tracked verbatims and 3 notices are still marked failed; see INDEX.md for per-document status.
Documents are not chunked or embedded here — the pgvector tables are built separately by parliament/scripts/init_db.py.

license.data: Derived from public parliamentary documents; attribution required
